comparison.objective: Set two sprinkler trip collars to define a 90-degree arc.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate two collar components to a specified relative angle.
comparison.success_condition: Blue pin is 90 degrees counter-clockwise from red and released; the record lacks tolerances and functional-cycle checks.
comparison.reason: It shares angular setting only; it does not establish concentric screw–jam-nut locking, countertorque, or retained actuation.
